name: Schooling Fish
text: If you win three or more tricks with diamonds in a round, gain +25 contract value.

signature.trigger: scoring, won 3+ tricks with hearts or diamonds

decision: Which diamond winners to cash to reach three wins.
opponent: Opponents see red-suit wins pile up and can pull trump or hold covers.
aiNote: Count red-suit winners when bidding; lead them once three are reachable.
rationale: About +10 per round for a flooded diamond suit and +4 otherwise; Heart Chorus has its own heart-win payoff in Swelling Sea (TE-R03).
deviation: Narrowed from hearts or diamonds to diamonds, so it serves one archetype.
